priorities.text: Differentiate on customer experience through new digital journeys

scenarios.diagnosis: Executives and staff describe two different organisations.
hypotheses: Which channels do executives rely on?
Is there an unfiltered upward route?
Do middle managers translate or buffer?
scenarios.name: Shadow culture
risks: Interventions read as out of touch

scenarios.diagnosis: Results are funded from discretionary effort that is running out.
hypotheses: Is the pace a deliberate strategic choice or an unmanaged default?
Are managers rewarded for output only?
Is recognition exclusively individual and commercial?
scenarios.name: Delivery without belonging

scenarios.diagnosis: Reward and recognition pay for the behaviour the organisation wants to stop.
hypotheses: Does variable pay reward the moderated orientation?
scenarios.name: Systems fighting the strategy

actions.intervention: Publicly celebrate a well-run experiment that failed, and share what was learned.
actions.objective: Make the INNOVATE shift visible within 30 days

actions.intervention: Name and reduce the GOVERN overplay that competes with INNOVATE; agree what stops.
actions.objective: Release GOVERN to make room for INNOVATE

actions.intervention: Run three 90-day customer-journey innovation sprints with a ring-fenced budget.
actions.objective: Build INNOVATE capability where it matters for the strategy

actions.intervention: Include an innovation or improvement objective in scorecards.
actions.objective: Change the system that sets INNOVATE behaviour

pathway.interventions: Innovation objectives in scorecards; sandbox time; pilot funding.

actions.intervention: CEO publicly recognises a manager for developing talent at an all-staff forum.
actions.objective: Make the ENGAGE shift visible within 30 days

actions.intervention: Name and reduce the PERFORM overplay that competes with ENGAGE; agree what stops.
actions.objective: Release PERFORM to make room for ENGAGE

actions.intervention: Coach-first leadership programme with a CDP-anchored 360 baseline and re-measure.
actions.objective: Build ENGAGE capability where it matters for the strategy

actions.intervention: Add a people-development objective to every manager’s scorecard.
actions.objective: Change the system that sets ENGAGE behaviour

actions.intervention: HR systems redesign within 90 days: performance management, promotion criteria, incentives and onboarding.
actions.objective: Stop paying for the behaviour the organisation wants to stop

pathway.interventions: Coach-first leadership development; CDP-anchored 360; wellbeing investment; team-based recognition.
pathway.narrative: “We perform best when our people are at their best.”

actions.intervention: Fix one visible process bottleneck staff complain about, and communicate what changed.
actions.objective: Make the GOVERN shift visible within 30 days

actions.intervention: Map the top five approval flows and remove at least two layers in each.
actions.objective: Moderate GOVERN capability where it matters for the strategy

actions.intervention: Clarify roles and include quality and compliance measures.
actions.objective: Change the system that sets GOVERN behaviour

pathway.narrative: Moderate the overplay; keep what protects the organisation.
